claim.text: The Rust-only Prolog interpreter can replace per-choice substitution HashMap clones with a single mutable binding store, reversible trail and lazy choicepoint continuation while preserving bounded observable query behavior
claim.scope: 45 native Rust tests on ELF64/i686; 149 paired Rust snapshot/trail CLI programs on one Linux ELF64 runner; five paired synthetic observations for 20k facts
assumptions: All alternatives undo to the checkpoint recorded before their branch was first entered
Monotonic freshening avoids variable-ID reuse on redo
Finite-term occurs-check continues to prohibit rational cycles
Pre-trail Rust commit is a behavioral regression oracle, not an independent Prolog semantics proof
forbidden_promotions: No full WAM term heap or garbage collector implemented
No complete ISO or GNU Prolog behavior claimed
No general performance superiority or speedup attributable solely to the trail
Do not hide first failed compilation or sub-resolution benchmark

specification.intended_object: Rust BindingStore with one HashMap+LIFO trail, deferred TryClause and Resume work frames and exact choicepoint trail marks
invariants: Each active binding is installed once and untrailed at checkpoint on redo
Failed partial unification restores all writes
Not-unifiable speculative matching always undoes writes
Query values read from live store before redo
Cut truncates current-invocation alternatives but does not untrail live current branch
First and later clause candidates execute in source order with lazy unification
Answer and failure results preserve observed Rust baseline behavior
known_answer_cases: p(f(a,b)). p(f(a,a)). queried p(f(X,X)) returns a only
root and child cut boundaries from Generation 12 remain correct
ancestor returns noah,mei; append returns [a,b,c]; member returns a,b,c
long alias chains and explicit occurs-check reject cycles

implementation.commit: branch rust/native-trail-choicepoints, commit e2c0808360c476551e695842431f2287bae8f088 before audit ledger
implementation.environment: Rust 1.85.1; Ubuntu 24.04, x86_64 ELF64, i686 ELF32 via multilib; Python 3.12 standard library, GNU /usr/bin/time
implementation.live_entrypoint: root Cargo workspace gprolog-rs CLI / parse_program + parse_query + engine::solve; snapshot baseline 2f4c7b9346c7bcdfcd177907049f67cfe957f4d4
implementation.representation: Rust HashMap mutable binding values and Vec trail IDs, ChoicePoint {trail_mark, Work}, no AST term arena and no per-choice substitution copy

metric.name: Full ordered CLI output parity and bounded resource comparison
metric.units: pass/fail cases per ABI; nanoseconds per subprocess including wrapper; peak resident memory KiB; ratios on synthetic workload only
equivalence_attacks: Partial-unifier prefix failure with sibling recovery
Root and nested cut before/after disjunction

black_box: 45 Rust tests on both ELF64 and genuine i686 ELF32, including ten new trail integration tests and three direct untrail unit tests
21 fixed and 128 deterministic generated programs compared full CLI stdout/stderr/exit with exact Rust snapshot
structural: Inspect engine.rs: no per-choice substitution clone; one BindingStore with reversible trail
Rust-only ELF tests verify no linked libgprolog
Full GNU Prolog C compiler/bootstrap regressions on PR head as noninterference control
property_based: 128 seeded fully-ground semicolon, cut, rules, facts with fixed PRNG seed 17262026
Existing 512 malformed-source parser cases remain in Rust metamorphic suite
metamorphic: Alpha renaming and fact order inversion preserve expected relation to output order
Rollback after failing compound unification returns correct next branch
Cut prunes earlier but not later alternatives
fuzzing: No coverage-guided fuzz, shrinking or arbitrary untrusted foreign memory tested
historical: Original 32-test Rust suite and C compiler/bootstrap regression history preserved
Snapshot Rust baseline built from immutable 2f4c7b9346c7bcdfcd177907049f67cfe957f4d4

matched_baselines: Same Rust compiler version builds immutable pre-trail Rust binary and candidate Rust binary
Identical Prolog input bytes, query, limits and runner for both binaries
negative_controls: Wrong binding must fail and untrail, not succeed
Failed speculative disequality must not poison next branch
A cut followed by failure still removes earlier alternatives
Memory/timing tiny 250-fact initial round explicitly classified inconclusive
controls.compute_parity: Rust 1.85.1, same runner/process type, five paired alternating AB/BA orders with two warmups each and resource observations per process
controls.parameter_parity: Max steps/max solutions and compiler release profile matched; output SHA compared
controls.sampling_parity: 21 fixed tests and seeded 128 generated cases; synthetic 20k fact workload same source for both
controls.data_access_parity: Exactly identical input file and query strings per matched pair

preregistration.prediction: Zero wrong ordered answers, no stale binding and both ABI test gates pass; benchmark effect must be measured separately
preregistration.primary_metric: Any Rust baseline/candidate stdout/stderr/exit mismatch or failed trail invariant blocks candidate
preregistration.uncertainty_method: Deterministic corpus for correctness; five paired synthetic runs descriptive without inferential CI; no external production workload sampling
preregistration.kill_condition: Any incorrect answer, stale rollback state, cut leak, ABI-specific failure, missing control or C execution dependency
preregistration.stop_condition: Do not build WAM heap/GC/foreign bridge to conceal a trail defect; no broad speed claim from one synthetic trial
preregistration.promotion_rule: H -> M only for bounded native trail behavior with exact matching and ABI pass; synthetic performance recorded as descriptive not generalized

WAM term heap, GC and ISO semantics -> no artifact; status H

result.observed: M: 45/45 Rust tests per ABI; 149/149 matched complete ELF64 CLI observables; same-output synthetic 20k facts and 5 paired runs with baseline median 20.987 ms vs candidate 15.026 ms, max RSS 16428 vs 14136 KiB. Neither causally isolates the trail nor validates full Prolog.
result.effect_size: Median synthetic wall-speed ratio 1.3967x and peak-RSS reduction 13.95% on one runner; five paired raw observations, no population uncertainty claimed
result.uncertainty: Same-author code/tests and snapshot baseline, single Linux CI runner family; 128 generated cases use limited grammar; speed conflates trail storage with deferred clause evaluation; other Prolog workloads/OS unknown
